title: The World Since 1945-present
description: Broad interpretive survey of the major forces that have shaped the world since the Second World War. Emphasis on the legacy of the Second World War, phases of the Cold War, decolonization and the rise of major states within the Third World, as well as on growing interdependence among states.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 112B, HIST 105, HIST 105B, HIST 242.
recommendations: HSTR 112, or HSTR 112A and HSTR 112B recommended for students wishing to take advanced courses in twentieth century history and comparative history.
